그가 언제 떠날 거라고 생각하니?
questions.explanation: When do you think he will leave? 순서이므로 4번째로 오는 단어는 think이다. (think류 동사는 의문사를 문장 맨 앞으로 보낸다.)

options: so
and
if
when
but
questions.question:
다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바꿔 쓸 때, 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
Do you know? + Is this train going to the station?
→ Do you know ___________ this train is going to the station?
questions.explanation: 의문사가 없는 의문문을 간접의문문으로 만들 때 '~인지 아닌지'를 뜻하는 if를 쓴다.

options: how
did
he
found
find
questions.question:
다음 우리말과 일치하도록 빈칸 (A)에 들어갈 단어를 <보기>에서 고르면?
[보기] how / did / find / found / he
나는 그 남자가 그것을 어떻게 찾았는지 알고 싶다.
I want to know ________ ________ (A)_______ it.
questions.explanation: 간접의문문은 「의문사 + 주어 + 동사」 어순이므로 how he found it이 되어 (A)에는 found가 들어간다.

options: where I can meet your brother
where the nearest station is
what kind of music she likes
what does he usually eat for lunch
how many books there are in this library
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 어색한 것은?
Do you know ________________________?
questions.explanation: 간접의문문은 「의문사 + 주어 + 동사」 어순이어야 하므로 what he usually eats for lunch가 되어야 한다.

options: what is he drinking now
where does she work
who is he
how tall the tower is
why does she come here
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
Can you tell me ________________________?
questions.explanation: 간접의문문은 「의문사 + 주어 + 동사」 어순이어야 하므로 how tall the tower is가 올바르다.

options: what day it is
when is the meeting
where is the exit
how long should I stay
when does the store open
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
Do you know ________________________?
questions.explanation: 간접의문문은 「의문사 + 주어 + 동사」 어순이어야 하므로 what day it is가 올바르다.

options: where Tom goes
where Tom went
where Tom will go
where did Tom go
where does Tom go
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
I wonder __________________ yesterday.
questions.explanation: 간접의문문은 「의문사+주어+동사」 어순이며, yesterday로 보아 과거시제여야 하므로 where Tom went가 적절하다.

options: what is the boy's name
what time the train leaves
when does she come back
where Sarah lives
who is the tall woman
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은? (정답 2개)
Do you know ________________________?
questions.explanation: 간접의문문은 「의문사+주어+동사」 어순을 지켜야 한다. what time the train leaves와 where Sarah lives가 올바른 어순이다. (정답 ②, ④)

options: how many hours your brother studies a day
why did your brother choose that school
who your brother's close friends are
what your brother wants to become
if your brother enjoys his classes
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은?
Do you know ________________________?
questions.explanation: 간접의문문에서는 do/did를 쓰지 않고 「의문사+주어+동사」 어순이어야 한다. why your brother chose가 옳다.

options: giving a gift to him
what he was reading in the library
the man wearing a blue coat
how I found my way back
where did I leave my umbrella
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은?
I don't remember _____________________.
questions.explanation: 간접의문문은 「의문사+주어+동사」 어순이므로 where I left my umbrella가 되어야 한다.

options: what the answer is
who built this bridge
if the news was real
what does he look like
how long were you waiting
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 적절하지 않은 것은? (정답 2개)
Can you tell me ______________________?
questions.explanation: 간접의문문은 「의문사+주어+동사」 어순이어야 한다. what he looks like, how long you were waiting가 옳다. (정답 ④, ⑤)

options: where is she
where she is
where she went
where she did go
where did she go
questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
A: I need to give my homework to Ms. Parker, but I don't know ______________________.
B: She is in the library. I can go with you.
questions.explanation: 선생님이 현재 도서관에 있으므로 현재시제 간접의문문 where she is가 적절하다.

options: where this place is
what's happening
who took the photo
what the matter is
when it was taken
questions.question:
다음 대화의 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
A: What are you looking at?
B: This photo. I'm curious about _________________.
A: It's Paris.
questions.explanation: A가 장소(Paris)로 대답하므로 '이곳이 어디인지'를 묻는 where this place is가 적절하다.

options: who sent the package
who did send the package
who the package is
who the package sent
who you sent the package
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
One morning a package arrived at my door. My name was on it, but nothing else was written. I don't know what is inside the package. Also, I don't know ________________________.
questions.explanation: 간접의문문에서 who가 주어일 때는 「who+동사」 어순으로 who sent the package가 옳다.

options: Do you know how can we protect the environment?
Do you know how we can protect the environment?
Do you know the way we can protect the environment?
Do you know the way that we can protect the environment?
Do you know the way in which we can protect the environment?
questions.question:
다음 빈칸에 들어갈 수 있는 질문 중 어법상 어색한 것은?
Q: _________________________________________?
A: We can protect the environment by recycling paper and plastic.
questions.explanation: 간접의문문은 「의문사+주어+동사」 어순이므로 how we can protect가 옳다. how can we는 어색하다.

options: ⓐ Could you introduce yourself to us?
ⓑ Can you tell us what your favorite subject is?
ⓒ Please let us know what your favorite sport is.
ⓓ Can you tell us your secrets to speaking French well?
ⓔ What do you want to do most if you become a scientist?
questions.question:
Choose the question that is not appropriate for the blanks ⓐ~ⓔ in the below dialogue.
Interview
Q1. ⓐ___________________________________________ 
A1. My name is Minji Park and I go to Hanguk Middle School in Korea. I am applying for this because I want to be a scientist.
Q2. ⓑ___________________________________________ 
A2. I like science most among all the subjects because studying it always excites me.
Q3. ⓒ___________________________________________, and how often you do it.
A3. My favorite sport is swimming. I do it three times a week to stay healthy.
Q4. ⓓ___________________________________________ 
A4. I'm good at French. My French communication skills might help me work with people from other countries.
Q5. ⓔ___________________________________________ 
A5. If I become a scientist, I want to discover a new medicine.
questions.explanation: A4의 대답은 프랑스어를 잘한다는 자신의 강점과 그 활용에 관한 내용이므로, '프랑스어를 잘하는 비결'을 묻는 질문은 적절하지 않다.

options: what are leaders
a leader makes what
what make a good leader
what makes a good leader
what a good leader makes
questions.question:
다음 밑줄 친 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은?
People may have different opinions about 무엇이 좋은 지도자를 만드는지.
questions.explanation: 간접의문문에서 what이 주어 역할을 하고 단수 취급하므로 what makes a good leader가 옳다.

options: I'm not sure when will the meeting start.
I'm not sure if the meeting will start.
I'm not sure where the meeting will start.
I'm not sure if will the meeting start.
I'm not sure when the meeting will start.
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은?
회의가 언제 시작될지 확실히 모르겠어요.
questions.explanation: '언제'라는 의미의 의문사 when을 쓰고 간접의문문 어순 「when+주어+동사」를 지킨 when the meeting will start가 옳다.

options: I wonder what time does the movie start.
I wonder the movie starts what time.
I wonder what time the movie starts.
I wonder what the movie starts time.
I wonder does the movie start what time.
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은?
나는 그 영화가 몇 시에 시작하는지 궁금해.
questions.explanation: 간접의문문의 어순은 '의문사(what time) + 주어(the movie) + 동사(starts)'이다. 조동사 does를 쓰지 않고 주어에 맞춰 동사를 변화시킨다.

options: Do you know who make the telephone?
Do you know who invented the telephone?
Who invented the telephone do you know?
Do you know who was inventing the telephone?
Who do you know invented the telephone?
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은?
너는 누가 전화기를 발명했는지 아니?
questions.explanation: 의문사 who가 주어인 간접의문문은 'who + 동사' 어순을 그대로 유지한다. 과거의 일이므로 invented가 알맞다.

options: How old do you know his brother is?
How old do you know is his brother?
Do you know how old his brother is?
Do you know how old is his brother?
Do you know is his brother how old?
questions.question:
다음 우리말을 바르게 영작한 것은?
너는 그의 형이 몇 살인지 아니?
questions.explanation: 간접의문문은 '의문사(how old) + 주어(his brother) + 동사(is)'의 평서문 어순이 되어야 한다.

options: if is there a bank near here
if there is a bank near here
there a is bank near here
is there a bank near here
how there is a bank near here
questions.question:
다음 문장을 간접의문문으로 바꿀 때, 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
Is there a bank near here?
→ I don't know ______________________________.
questions.explanation: 의문사가 없는 의문문을 간접의문문으로 바꿀 때는 'if/whether + 주어 + 동사' 어순이 된다.

options: if I had enjoyed the book
if you enjoy the book
if I enjoyed the book
whether I enjoy the book
whether you enjoyed the book
questions.question:
다음 문장을 간접의문문으로 바꿀 때, 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
He said to me, "Do you enjoy the book?"
→ He asked me __________________________________.
questions.explanation: 주절이 과거(asked)이므로 시제를 일치시켜 enjoyed로 쓰고, 인칭도 you를 I로 바꾼다.

options: Jane ask me when the show begin.
Jane asks me when the show begins.
Jane asked me when the show began.
Jane asks me when does the show begin.
Jane asked me when did the show begin.
questions.question:
다음 문장을 간접의문문으로 바르게 바꾼 것은?
Jane says to me, "When does the show begin?"
questions.explanation: 주절이 현재(says)이므로 asks, 간접의문문은 'when + 주어 + 동사(begins)' 어순이 된다.

options: Where will you go? → Let me know where you'll go.
What did he say? → Tell me what he said.
How long does it last? → Can I ask you how long it lasts?
Who is she? → I asked them who she was.
Who broke the window? → I wonder did who break the window.
questions.question: 다음 직접의문문을 간접의문문으로 바꿀 때, 어법상 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: 의문사 who가 주어인 간접의문문은 'who + 동사(broke)' 어순을 그대로 써야 한다. did를 넣으면 안 된다.

options: where the train stopped next
where the train will stop next
where the train stops next
where does the train stop next
where does the train stops next
questions.question:
다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 만들 때, 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
Could you tell me? + Where does the train stop next?
→ Could you tell me _____________________________?
questions.explanation: 간접의문문은 '의문사 + 주어 + 동사' 어순이며, 원문이 현재시제이므로 stops가 알맞다.

options: if the color matches her dress well
whether does the color match her dress well
if her the color match dress well
that the color matches her dress well
the color match her dress well
questions.question:
다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 만들 때, 빈칸에 들어갈 말로 가장 적절한 것은?
I wonder. + Does the color match her dress well?
→ I wonder ______________________________________.
questions.explanation: 의문사가 없는 의문문의 간접의문문은 'if + 주어 + 동사' 어순이며, 주어 the color에 맞춰 matches를 쓴다.

options: I'd like to know when he arrives at the station.
I'd like to know when he arrived at the station.
I'd like to know when arrived he at the station.
I'd like to know when he has arrived at the station.
I'd like to know when did he arrived at the station.
questions.question:
다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 만들 때 가장 적절한 것은?
• I'd like to know.
• When did he arrive at the station?
questions.explanation: 간접의문문은 'when + 주어 + 동사' 어순이며, 원문이 과거이므로 arrived가 알맞다.

options: What can you tell me he answered?
What can you tell me he answers?
Can you tell me what he answers?
Can you tell me what he answered?
Can you tell me what did he answer?
questions.question:
다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 만들 때 가장 적절한 것은?
• Can you tell me?
• What did he answer?
questions.explanation: 간접의문문은 'what + 주어 + 동사' 어순이며, 원문이 과거이므로 answered가 알맞다.

options: Can you tell me Cinderella met the prince?
Can you tell me did Cinderella meet the prince?
Can you tell me did if Cinderella meet the prince?
Can you tell me if Cinderella met the prince?
Can you tell me if Cinderella meets the prince?
questions.question:
다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 만들 때 가장 적절한 것은?
• Can you tell me?
• Did Cinderella meet the prince?
questions.explanation: 의문사가 없는 의문문의 간접의문문은 'if + 주어 + 동사' 어순이며, 원문이 과거이므로 met이 알맞다.

options: Where can you tell me she works?
Can you tell me where she works?
Can you tell me where she does work?
Can you tell me where does she work?
Where can you tell me does she work?
questions.question:
다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 만들 때 가장 적절한 것은?
• Can you tell me?
• Where does she work?
questions.explanation: 간접의문문은 「의문사 + 주어 + 동사」 어순을 따르며, 조동사 do/does는 사라지고 본동사에 인칭·시제를 반영해야 합니다. 따라서 'where she works'가 옳습니다.

options: Do you think what he cooked for them?
Do you think what did he cook for them?
What do you think he cooked for them?
What do you think did he cook for them?
What do you think did he cooked for them?
questions.question:
다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 만들 때 가장 적절한 것은?
• Do you think?
• What did he cook for them?
questions.explanation: think, believe, suppose 등의 동사와 간접의문문이 결합할 때는 의문사를 문장 맨 앞으로 보내야 합니다. 따라서 「What do you think + 주어 + 동사」인 'What do you think he cooked for them?'이 옳습니다.

options: Do you think why Jinsu skipped lunch today?
Do you think why did Jinsu skip lunch today?
Why do you think Jinsu skipped lunch today?
Why do you think why Jinsu skip lunch today?
Why do you think why did Jinsu skip lunch today?
questions.question:
다음 두 문장을 한 문장으로 만들 때 가장 적절한 것은?
• Do you think?
• Why did Jinsu skip lunch today?
questions.explanation: think가 쓰인 간접의문문은 의문사를 문두로 이동시키고, 의문사는 한 번만 씁니다. 따라서 'Why do you think Jinsu skipped lunch today?'가 옳습니다.

options: I want to know. + How did he fix it? → I want to know how he fixes it?
Can you tell me? + When did they arrive here? → Can you tell me when they arrived here?
Do you know? + Which color does Bora like? → Which color do you know Bora likes?
Ask him. + What made him choose art? → What asks him choose art?
I'd like to know. + What game is Junho playing? → I'd like to know what is Junho playing game.
questions.question: 다음 중 두 문장을 한 문장으로 바르게 바꾼 것은?
questions.explanation: 간접의문문은 「의문사 + 주어 + 동사」 어순이며 시제를 유지해야 합니다. ②의 'when they arrived here'가 올바른 형태입니다. 나머지는 어순·시제·조동사 처리가 잘못되었습니다.

options: I asked you + Why were they upset? → I asked you why they were upset.
Tell me + What did he write? → Tell me what he wrote.
I wonder + Who broke the window? → I wonder who broke the window.
Can I ask you? + How old is she? → Can I ask you how old she is.
I'd like to know + Where did you stay? → I'd like to know where you stay.
questions.question: When we combine two sentences into one sentence, which one is NOT proper?
questions.explanation: ⑤는 원래 문장이 과거시제(did you stay)이므로 간접의문문에서도 'where you stayed'가 되어야 합니다. 'where you stay'는 시제가 잘못되었습니다.

options: What is he making? + Do you know? → Do you know what he is making?
Where is the library? + Do you know? → Do you know where the library is?
Where can I buy tickets? + Tell me. → Tell me where can I buy tickets.
Who is he? + Do you know? → Do you know who he is?
How old is she? + I want to know. → I want to know how old she is.
questions.question: 다음 중 두 문장을 한 문장으로 연결할 때 어색한 것은?
questions.explanation: ③의 간접의문문은 「의문사 + 주어 + 동사」 어순이어야 하므로 'Tell me where I can buy tickets.'가 되어야 합니다. 'where can I buy'는 의문문 어순이라 어색합니다.

options: I asked you. + Why were they upset? → I asked you why they were upset.
Tell me. + What did he say? → Tell me what he said.
Do you suppose? + Who ate my sandwich? → Do you suppose who ate my sandwich?
Do you think? + Why did he quit his team? → Why do you think he quit his team?
I'd like to know. + Where did you travel? → I'd like to know where you traveled.
questions.question: When we combine the two sentences into one, which is NOT appropriate?
questions.explanation: suppose, think 등의 동사가 간접의문문과 결합하면 의문사를 문두로 보내야 합니다. 따라서 ③은 'Who do you suppose ate my sandwich?'가 되어야 합니다.

options: We had to study harder, but we didn't. → We shouldn't have studied harder.
My brother is angry because I didn't keep my promise. → I should have kept my promise.
I need to know. Where did you put my keys? → I need to know where you put my keys.
I didn't call Mina yesterday. I'm sorry I didn't call her. → I should have called Mina yesterday.
Please tell me. How long must I stay here? → Please tell me how long I must stay here.
questions.question: Which one is NOT correct?
questions.explanation: '해야 했는데 하지 않아 후회'하는 상황이므로 'We should have studied harder.'가 되어야 합니다. 'shouldn't have p.p.'는 '하지 말았어야 했는데 했다'는 의미라 문맥과 맞지 않습니다.

options: Tell me _______ happens next.
I don't know _______ his excuse was real.
I want to know _______ the answer is.
Please let us know _______ you decide.
I don't know _______ her house looks like.
questions.question: 다음 중 빈칸에 들어갈 말이 나머지 넷과 다른 것은?

Do you suppose how fast he can swim?
The girls wonder whether he is their new teacher.
I told her what the answer was.
He wondered what does cause a sound like that.
questions.question: Choose two grammatically incorrect sentences.
questions.explanation: ②는 suppose가 있으므로 'How fast do you suppose he can swim?'이 되어야 하고, ⑤는 what이 주어인 간접의문문이므로 does 없이 'what causes a sound like that'이 되어야 한다.

I don't understand why they are upset.

questions.question: 다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장은? (정답 2개)
questions.explanation: 간접의문문은 '의문사+주어+동사' 어순이므로 ①은 'where he is from', ⑤는 'when the fire broke out'이 되어야 한다. 간접의문문에서는 do/did 조동사를 쓰지 않는다.

The boy knows how it is difficult to become a doctor.

questions.explanation: ③ whether로 시작하는 간접의문문 어순이 올바르다. ④ how many books+주어+동사 어순이 올바르다. ②는 'how difficult it is', ⑤는 think가 있으므로 'Which do you think is faster'가 되어야 한다.

questions.question:
다음 괄호 (A), (B), (C) 안에서 어법에 맞는 표현으로 가장 적절한 것은?

• I want to know who (B)[got the letter / did the letter get] yesterday.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장의 총 개수는?
(A) Do you believe where you lost it?
(B) What do you think she is doing now?
(C) I don't know who broke the window.
(D) Tell me who are your children's best friends.
(E) Do you know what your parents do for a living?
(F) I wonder why was Kate dating Mike yesterday.
(G) Do you know how many hours your parents slept last night?
questions.explanation: 옳은 문장은 (B), (C), (E), (G) 총 4개다. (A)는 believe류 동사이므로 'Where do you believe you lost it?'이 되어야 하고, (D)와 (F)는 간접의문문 '의문사+주어+동사' 어순('who your children's best friends are', 'why Kate was dating Mike')이 되어야 한다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
ⓐ Do you know who is she?
ⓑ Can you tell me what brought you here?
ⓒ Do you know who did eat the most pizza?
ⓓ She didn't even tell me what her name was.
ⓔ Do you know if Judy can play the violin?
questions.explanation: ⓑ what이 주어인 간접의문문, ⓓ 'what her name was' 어순, ⓔ if절 모두 올바르다. ⓐ는 'who she is'가 되어야 하고, ⓒ는 who가 주어이므로 did 없이 'who eats the most pizza'가 되어야 한다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
ⓐ Please tell me how is Tom.
ⓑ Do you think what he should do?
ⓒ Does he know where his cousin lives?
ⓓ Can you tell me who did break the window?
ⓔ I wonder if you will come to my graduation party.
questions.explanation: ⓒ 'where his cousin lives', ⓔ if절이 올바른 간접의문문이다. ⓐ는 'how Tom is', ⓑ는 think가 있으므로 'What do you think he should do?', ⓓ는 who가 주어이므로 did 없이 'who broke the window'가 되어야 한다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 옳은 문장끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
ⓐ I can't remember what did Minho do then.
ⓑ I want to know whether I can borrow your bike.
ⓒ I wonder how long you will be staying here.
ⓓ Do you know what time the movie start?
ⓔ Do you think who can solve the puzzle?
questions.explanation: ⓑ whether절, ⓒ 'how long+주어+동사' 어순이 올바르다. ⓐ는 did 없이 'what Minho did then', ⓓ는 주어가 3인칭 단수이므로 'starts', ⓔ는 think가 있으므로 'Who do you think can solve the puzzle?'이 되어야 한다.

questions.question:
Choose all the sentences that are grammatically wrong from the box below.
(A) Do you think why she is so cheerful?
(B) Can you tell me where did you go?
(C) I don't know how I should get there.
(D) What do you know the price of this bag is?
(E) I don't know how did the accident happen.
(F) I wonder why you decided to move to another city.
questions.explanation: (A)는 think가 있으므로 'Why do you think she is so cheerful?', (B)·(E)는 간접의문문에 do/did를 쓰지 않으므로 'where you went'·'how the accident happened', (D)는 know 뒤 간접의문문이므로 'Do you know what the price of this bag is?'가 되어야 한다. 따라서 틀린 것은 (A), (B), (D), (E)이다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 어색한 문장끼리 바르게 짝지어진 것은?
(a) I don't know that she will join the club or not.
(b) Can you tell me when your birthday is?
(c) She asks me when we will meet.
(d) Do you know who did draw this?
(e) I don't know who is telling the truth.
(f) Do you think why she cried?
questions.explanation: (a)는 that이 아니라 whether/if를 써야 하고, (d)는 'who drew this'로 did를 빼야 하며, (f)는 think가 있으므로 'Why do you think she cried?'가 되어야 한다. 따라서 어색한 문장은 (a), (d), (f)이다.

questions.question:
Choose all the sentences that are grammatically correct.
ⓐ I want to know where you live.
ⓑ Do you know what book she want to read?
ⓒ What kind of hobby do I want to start?
ⓓ Do you think I should sleep more?
ⓔ Do you think what I can bring for you?
ⓕ What do you think you want to buy?
ⓖ The man wants to know how old is she.
questions.explanation: ⓐ 'where you live' 어순 맞음. ⓒ 직접의문문으로 어순 맞음. ⓓ think 뒤 의문사 없는 간접의문문 맞음. ⓕ think+의문사 문두 어순 맞음. ⓑ는 she 뒤에 wants가 와야 하고, ⓔ는 what이 문두로 나와야 하며, ⓖ는 'how old she is'가 되어야 한다. 따라서 옳은 것은 ⓐ, ⓒ, ⓓ, ⓕ이다.

questions.question:
Choose all the sentences that are grammatically wrong from the box below.
ⓐ Can you guess why they built this?
ⓑ Do you suppose what made her leave early?
ⓒ I don't really know when is the meeting over.
ⓓ He asked me how did she call me often.
ⓔ Let's ask him who the girl in the photo is.
ⓕ I'm not sure when she left the station.
ⓖ I didn't know how I solved the problem.
ⓗ Do you think why he's so surprised?
questions.explanation: ⓑsuppose는 Yes/No 의문문이므로 what이 문두로 나와야 함(틀림). ⓒ간접의문문은 'when the meeting is over' 어순이어야 함(틀림). ⓓ간접의문문은 'how she called me' 어순이어야 함(틀림). ⓗthink처럼 suppose류는 의문사가 문두로 나와야 함(틀림). 따라서 ⓑ, ⓒ, ⓓ, ⓗ.

questions.question:
Choose all the sentences that are grammatically wrong from the box below.
ⓐ How can you believe he wrote the poem himself?
ⓑ Why do you think he will finish on time?
ⓒ I don't know when he can join our team.
ⓓ Do you imagine what the giant squid looks like?
ⓔ Can you tell me where did he go yesterday?
ⓕ Why do you think she would rather stay home?
ⓖ Do you suppose what time the show will begin?
ⓗ Where do you know the library is?
questions.explanation: ⓓ imagine, ⓖ suppose는 think류 동사이므로 의문사가 문두로 나와야 하고, ⓔ는 간접의문문에 did를 쓰지 않으므로 'where he went yesterday', ⓗ는 know 뒤 간접의문문이므로 'Do you know where the library is?'가 되어야 한다. 따라서 틀린 것은 ⓓ, ⓔ, ⓖ, ⓗ이다.

questions.question:
다음 괄호 안의 단어를 알맞게 배열하여 문장을 완성하시오.

The scary movie (sister, made, my, frightened).
→ The scary movie ___________________________.
questions.explanation: 「make + 목적어 + 형용사」 구조로 '~을 …하게 만들다'를 나타낸다. 목적어(my sister) 뒤에 형용사(frightened)를 배열한다.

questions.question:
다음 우리말과 같도록 주어진 단어로 시작하는 문장을 완성하시오.

독서는 너의 마음을 편안하게 만든다.

= Reading ______________ ______________ ______________ ______________.
questions.explanation: 주어 Reading은 단수 취급하므로 makes를 쓴다. 「make + 목적어(your mind) + 형용사(calm)」 형태로 완성한다.
acceptedAnswers: makes your mind comfortable
makes your mind relaxed

questions.question:
다음 우리말과 같도록 주어진 단어로 시작하는 문장을 완성하시오.

발표는 항상 그를 불안하게 만든다.

= The presentation ______________ ______________ ______________
______________.
questions.explanation: 빈도부사 always는 일반동사 makes 앞에 위치한다. 「make + 목적어(him) + 형용사(anxious)」 구조이다.
acceptedAnswers: always makes him nervous
always makes him uneasy

questions.question:
다음 우리말과 같은 의미가 되도록 괄호 안의 단어를 이용하여 문장을 완성하시오.

이 세제를 사용하는 것은 옷을 신선하게 만듭니다. Using this detergent ________________________________. (fresh, make, clothes, the)
questions.explanation: 동명사 주어 Using this detergent는 단수 취급하므로 makes를 쓰고, 「make + 목적어(the clothes) + 형용사(fresh)」로 배열한다.

questions.question:
다음 문장을 동사 make를 활용하여 뜻이 같은 다른 문장으로 바꾸어 쓰시오.

I am nervous because of the exam. → The exam _________________________________.
questions.explanation: '시험이 나를 긴장하게 만든다'로 바꾼다. 주어 The exam은 단수이므로 makes, 「make + 목적어(me) + 형용사(nervous)」로 쓴다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 어색한 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰시오.

The story made him boring.  ※ 틀린 부분을 고쳐서 올바른 문장으로 전부 쓰세요.
questions.explanation: 사람이 지루함을 느끼는 것이므로 감정을 받는 대상에는 과거분사 형태의 형용사 bored를 써야 한다. boring은 '지루하게 만드는'의 뜻이다.

questions.question:
다음 중 어법상 어색한 부분을 찾아 바르게 고쳐 쓰시오.

He made the windows opened.  ※ 틀린 부분을 고쳐서 올바른 문장으로 전부 쓰세요.
questions.explanation: 「make + 목적어 + 형용사」 구조에서 목적어의 상태를 나타내는 형용사 open을 써야 한다. opened(과거분사)는 이 자리에 어울리지 않는다.

이야기를 읽는 것은 나를 신나게 만든다.
questions.explanation: 동명사 주어 Reading stories는 단수 취급하므로 makes를 쓰고, 「make + 목적어(me) + 형용사(excited)」로 쓴다.
acceptedAnswers: Reading stories makes me excited

questions.question:

다음 단어들을 이용하여 우리말로 제시한 세 가지 문장을 영어로 쓰시오. (단, 한 번도 쓰이지 않거나 중복으로 쓰이는 단어가 있을 수 있음)

게임은 우리가 신나도록 만든다.
questions.explanation: 단수 주어 A game에는 makes를 쓰고, 「make + 목적어(us) + 형용사(excited)」로 완성한다.
acceptedAnswers: A game makes us excited

questions.question:
다음 우리말에 맞게 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.

그 강의는 학생들을 졸리게 만든다.

→ The lecture __________________________________.
questions.explanation: 단수 주어 The lecture에는 makes를 쓰고, 「make + 목적어(students) + 형용사(sleepy)」로 표현한다.
acceptedAnswers: makes the students sleepy

questions.question:
다음 우리말에 맞게 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.

나는 방을 깨끗하게 유지하기 위해 노력했다.

questions.explanation: 「keep + 목적어 + 형용사」는 '~을 …한 상태로 유지하다'의 뜻이다. keep the room clean으로 표현한다.
acceptedAnswers: keep my room clean

questions.question:
다음 우리말에 맞게 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.

너는 그 약속을 영원히 지킬 수 없어.

→ You ________________________________________________.
questions.explanation: 조동사 can의 부정 can't 뒤에 동사원형 keep, 목적어 the promise, 부사 forever 순으로 배열합니다. '지킬 수 없다'는 can't keep입니다.
acceptedAnswers: cannot keep the promise forever

questions.question:
다음 우리말에 맞게 빈칸에 알맞은 말을 쓰시오.

음악을 듣는 것은 나를 편안하게 만든다.

→ Listening to music ___________________________________.
questions.explanation: 동명사 주어(Listening to music)는 단수 취급하므로 makes를 쓰고, 「make + 목적어(me) + 형용사(relaxed)」의 5형식 구조로 씁니다.
acceptedAnswers: makes me comfortable
makes me calm

The thick coat will keep you ______________.
questions.explanation: 두꺼운 코트는 너를 '따뜻하게' 유지해 줍니다. 「keep + 목적어 + 형용사」 구조로 warm이 알맞습니다.

questions.question:

Studying all night will make you ____________.

questions.question:
[보기] angry / happy / tired / warm

다음 <보기>에서 알맞은 것을 골라 문장을 완성하시오.

Spending time with friends will keep you ______________.
questions.explanation: 친구들과 시간을 보내는 것은 너를 '행복하게' 유지해 줍니다. 「keep + 목적어 + 형용사」 구조로 happy가 알맞습니다.

questions.question:
[보기] angry / happy / tired / warm

다음 <보기>에서 알맞은 것을 골라 문장을 완성하시오.

People who break their word may make you ______________.
questions.explanation: 약속을 어기는 사람들은 너를 '화나게' 만들 수 있습니다. 「make + 목적어 + 형용사」 구조로 angry가 알맞습니다.

questions.question:

<예시> Singing makes me happy.

Smartphones ___________________________________.
